title: Create: Bedo's Factory
description: A tech and automation modpack built around the Create mod, specially optimized for lower-end systems to let you design and build massive automated factories without lag.
body:
Welcome to Create: Bedo's Factory!

Are you ready to dive into the world of industrial automation? Create: Bedo's Factory is a carefully curated modpack designed for those who love mechanical engineering, complex production lines, and endless creativity. Built around the amazing Create mod, this pack offers a balanced and immersive experience for players who want to build the factory of their dreams.

Why choose this pack?

Focus on Automation: From simple farms to massive, self-sustaining industrial complexes, you have all the tools you need to automate everything.

Performance-Optimized: We’ve included essential optimization mods like Embeddium and ModernFix to ensure your game runs smoothly, even with complex machines running.

Enhanced Experience: With added content from Create add-ons and various utility mods, your building process will be more efficient and enjoyable.

This pack is all about the joy of engineering. Whether you are a beginner looking to understand the basics of kinetic energy or an expert builder aiming to construct the most complex contraptions, there is something here for you. Start small, expand your operations, and watch your factory come to life!

Building Factories, Having Fun! Note: This pack is updated regularly. Please make sure to report any issues you encounter so we can continue improving your experience.
